Platôs em degraus, Arena emoldurada, Cân: Stepped plateaus, Framed arena, Branching canyons and Twin rivers. Bastions facing the enemy (towers, anti-air, shield, artillery and a factory), workshops on the sides (land and air factories, energy) and a rear with energy, research and radar.
Cada bairro vai para chão plano e seco,: Each district goes on flat, dry ground inside the AI's own territory (closer to its home than to anyone else's), where it has not built anything yet. Bastions prefer narrow passages and high ground toward the enemy, and districts near the map's expansions and defensive points come first. It does not build where enemies are nearby.
A base principal e as expansões do jogo: The game's main base and expansions packed every building into a 60 × 60 square. Now the base grows from the center outward with a street between buildings, over an area about 5 times larger: factories are spread out and units come out without jams.
Engenheiros próprios e painel: Its own engineers and the panel

IA estrategista: formações, duas frentes: Strategist AI: formations, two fronts, siege, attack prediction and a mini map in the panel

Base que se protege e economia que se aj: A base that protects itself and an economy that adjusts
Escudos sobre os blocos de fábricas (doi: Shields over the factory blocks (two over the big ones), anti-air spread between the base and the districts when the enemy has an air force, one more factory when mass piles up and generators when energy runs short. Formação no ataque: tanques na frente, a: Formation in attacks: tanks in front, artillery firing from behind and anti-air escorting the front line. A large army attacks on two fronts at once. Siege: it goes for the extractors far from the enemy base before the final assault. The army gathers in front of the bastion and falls back behind its towers. Experimentals leave with an anti-air escort.
Vê um exército inimigo se juntando e and: It sees an enemy army gathering and walking toward one of its places and waits in front of it. Bairros em volta da base principal em ch: Districts around the main base on good ground (bastions with towers facing the enemy, workshops with factories, a rear, an experimental forge and harbors), streets between buildings, shields over the factories, an anti-air network, rebuilding what falls and an economy that adjusts.
O ponto de partida da IA. Depois ela se: The AI's starting point. Then it adapts by itself to you and to the map during the match and between matches (the F4 panel shows the genes and every change).

O centro da IA agora são nove genes (agr: The core of the AI is now nine genes (aggression, patience, expansion, defense, scouting, raids, tech, air force and navy). They start from what it learned in earlier matches (per map and in general), change a little every match and adjust during the game: failed attacks, what kills its units, your style, the map, the economy and the districts it loses. Every change shows in the journal with the reason. Each win of yours makes the next AI a bit stronger.
Joga sem ver o mapa, como um jogador: Plays without seeing the map, like a player
A IA só sabe o que viu: no começo avisa: The AI only knows what it has seen: at the start it says it cannot see the whole map and sends a plane (or a fast unit) to your base, and looks again every few minutes. What it researches and builds against you comes from what its scouts saw. With the whole map revealed, it sees everything like you.
Escolhe duas estratégias por vez entre 2: It picks two strategies at a time out of 25 (fast expansion, economic dominance, air supremacy, fortified defense, experimentals, commander pressure, naval dominance, simultaneous attacks, economic pressure, flanks, long range artillery, anti-nuke defense, engineer protection, team coordination and more) and switches when the game changes.
Ataca na hora certa (quando o seu exérci: It attacks at the right moment (when your army just lost or is far from home), hides an ambush beside the route you use, sends a decoy before the main attack, brings shields down with artillery first, takes over the extractors it destroys, reclaims wreckage, fighters patrol between districts, bombers come back to your weak spots, veterans return home earlier, engineers run from enemies and the commander advances with the army early on.
Pesquisa com plano (pela personalidade e: Research with a plan (by personality and genes), commander upgrades at the right time (armor when hit, weapons when advancing), experimental race (destroys your factory or rushes its own), anti-nuke defense when you have a missile, a nuke when it is winning late in the game, mass converters and a second line of towers between the bastions and the base.
Nível Mestre (pensa a cada 2 segundos),: Master level (thinks every 2 seconds), Engineer, Blitz and Experimental personalities, Alsyper controls (aggressiveness, districts, air force, navy), training mode with on-screen tips, the AI talking during the match and, in the "What the AI learned" card, the genes and the result of the last matches.
IA: comandante seguro e marinha na medid: AI: a safe commander and the right amount of navy
As obras do jogo mandavam o comandante c: The game's build jobs sent the commander to build extractors, defenses and shipyards far from the base, where it died. Those jobs now go only to engineers. If the commander still goes more than 100 units from the base, it comes back and an engineer finishes the job in its place; the factory makes a new engineer if none is free. After two times, the commander leaves the game's build jobs and guards the base. The Commander pressure strategy now only takes it to the front of the base.
Só um estaleiro por base e metade do orç: Only one shipyard per base and half the naval budget. Counter ships only when the scouts have seen an enemy navy, and only enough to face it. A harbor only on maps with plenty of water (or for an AI that learned to use the sea). With little water, the naval personality plays balanced and the Naval dominance strategy rarely comes up.
IA: bairro Ressurreição e construtores e: AI: the Resurrection district and hidden builders
Depois dos primeiros minutos, a IA plane: After the first minutes, the AI plans a hidden base far from its main one: on flat ground, away from the routes you use and from the places where it lost units, closer to its own home than to yours. The base is heavily fortified (four towers, three anti-air, three shields, a land factory and an air factory), has no radar and does not show on the panel's minimap. If the commander dies or the main base is falling, this base becomes the builders' priority, and its factory keeps sending an army to attack.
A IA pesquisa a cápsula de fuga do coman: The AI researches the commander's escape pod. When the commander is nearly destroyed and under attack, the AI launches the pod, which flies to the Resurrection district (or another hidden place) and builds a new commander there. The new commander stays at that base until the main one is rebuilt and safe.
A IA esconde engenheiros pelo mapa: um e: The AI hides engineers around the map: one on land (two on the harder levels) and one on the water when the map has sea, far from the enemy and from each other. If they are found, they move to another hiding place. If the main base is destroyed, they come out and build a new factory: at the base if it is clear, or right where they were hiding. In Supremacy and Infinite War, the AI keeps playing even without a commander.
